title: TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and ADMINISTRATIVE AND CATEGORICAL EXEMPTIONS relative to a five-year contract, with two one-year renewal…
text:
[Council File 26-1484]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and ADMINISTRATIVE AND CATEGORICAL EXEMPTIONS relative to a five-year contract, with two one-year renewal options, with A to Z Glass & Mirror Inc. for glass and storefront systems and installation at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) and Van Nuys Airport (VNY).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. CONCUR with the Board of Airport Commissioners' adoption of staff's determination that the requested action is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article II, Section 2(f) and Article III, Class 1(2) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines.
2. APPROVE the award of a five-year contract, with two one-year renewal options, to A to Z Glass & Mirror Inc. for glass and storefront systems and installation at LAX and VNY, for an amount not to exceed $2,345,000.
3. CONCUR with the Board's action on October 14, 2026, by Resolution No. 28490, authorizing the Los Angeles World Airports Chief Executive Officer, or designee, to execute said contract with A to Z Glass & Mirror Inc., subject to approval as to form by the City Attorney.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board of Airport Commissioners reports that costs incurred under the contract will be recovered through terminal rates and charges, landing fees, and non- aeronautical revenues. There is no impact to the General Fund. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - DECEMBER 15, 2026
